headline: Avalon Holdings Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Avalon Holdings Corporation announced financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting net operating revenues of $24.3 million compared to $25.7 million in the third quarter of 2025.
why: Avalon Holdings Corporation is a publicly traded company listed on the NYSE American exchange, providing waste management and other business services.
